title: Inequalities (One Variable)
description: Learn to solve and graph Inequalities in one variable for Grade 7: inequality symbols, number line graphs, compound inequalities and real-life applications.

topics.title: Solving & Graphing Inequalities
topics.concept:
Inequalities compare expressions using symbols instead of an equals sign.

SymbolMeaningGraph (circle type)
<less thanopen circle (not included)
>greater thanopen circle (not included)
≤less than or equal toclosed circle (included)
≥greater than or equal toclosed circle (included)

Critical Rule: When you multiply or divide both sides by a negative number, you must reverse (flip) the inequality sign!

Example: -2x < 10 => divide by -2, flip sign => x > -5
topics.visual:

CRITICAL RULE: Multiply/divide by NEGATIVE -> FLIP sign!

questions.q: The graph of x >= -4 has what type of circle at -4?
questions.explanation: The symbol >= means the value is included, so a closed (filled) circle is used.

questions.q: Which inequality matches: 'You need at least 50 points to pass'?
questions.explanation: 'At least 50' means 50 or more, so p >= 50.
